senses.gloss: m. (a corrupt. of פִּינוֹלֵס q. v.) travelling cloak.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 84:16">Gen. R. s. 84</cite> (ref. to <he>ויפשיטו</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 37:23">Gen. XXXVII, 23</cite>) <he>זה הפ׳</he> this refers to his cloak; Yalk. ib. 142. Ib. 133 <he>עד שמכר פ׳ שלו</he> when he was compelled to sell his travelling cloak; (Yalk. Gen. s. 78 <he>הסוס שלו</he>).
